minutes.headline: Planning Board approved two ANRs, the Northfield Road common driveway and a hydrant change; Bright Farms hearing continued to Sept 28.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board approved two ANR plans, a common driveway and scenic road permit on Northfield Road, and a de minimis change at Baker Brook. It opened the Bright Farms greenhouse site plan and stormwater hearing and continued it. In workshop it agreed to schedule a hearing on amending the ANR rules and heard a long report on the TC Passios building committee's fall Town Meeting timing.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the Northfield Road common driveway and scenic road application after closing its public hearing.
The board approved two ANR plans, for 237 Prospect Street and 422 Multiples Road.
The Bright Farms greenhouse site plan and stormwater hearing was continued to September 28, and the applicant may work with the review engineer meanwhile.
The board approved a de minimis change at Baker Brook Tri-Town Landing to remove an extra water main and hydrant.
The board agreed to schedule an end-of-October hearing on amending the ANR subdivision rules, and heard a long report on fall Town Meeting timing for TC Passios.

why_it_matters: Borrowing for the TC Passios renovation would need a debt exclusion and a special election, so residents could be asked to vote and to accept a higher tax bill if it goes to a fall Town Meeting.
The proposed change to the ANR rules could alter what landowners must show, and pay for, when dividing land, and the public hearing is where residents can comment.
watch_next: September 28, 6:35 p.m.: continued Bright Farms hearing.
End-of-October public hearing on the ANR subdivision rules amendment; the draft is due in the next meeting packet.

The official minutes record no vote to close the Northfield hearing and no Bright Farms continuation, and name the chair and attendees differently from our captions.
